title: Wichita Area Investment Property Analysis | Alexander Colón
description: Send Alex an address and he works the rent, the full carrying cost, and what is left. Including the times the answer is that the numbers do not work.
h1: Send an address and get the numbers worked, including when they do not work
job: Prove analytical competence on a specific property so the investor treats Alex as the person who screens their deals.
primaryPrinciple: Authority through specificity. The analysis is the sales argument.

bands.headline: Real estate investing starts with the numbers.
bands.support: Whether you are looking at a first rental or adding another property, the question is the same: what does it cost, what does it rent for, and what is left. Alex owns rental property himself and looks at these from both the agent side and the owner side.

ctas.label: Run the numbers on this one

bands.heading: Long-term rental analysis
body: Purchase price, financing, rent and the running costs, worked through to monthly cash flow, NOI, cash-on-cash return and how long the cash you put in takes to come back.

items.q: Will you tell me a deal is bad?
items.a: Yes, and that is most of the value. An agent who approves every address you send is not screening anything, they are processing paperwork.

items.q: Do you work with people buying their first rental?
items.a: Yes. The analysis is the same either way, and the first one is where an honest second opinion is worth the most.

items.q: Can you look at more than one address at a time?
items.a: Send them together. Comparing several properties side by side is more useful than looking at one in isolation, and it is faster to work them as a batch.

items.q: What about properties that need significant work?
items.a: Those need a scope and a contractor number before the analysis means anything. Alex will tell you when a property cannot be evaluated responsibly without one rather than guessing at a rehab figure.
